elements.requirement: In this Part of the Family Law Act 1996, the term "the court" must be read with section 63M.
elements.quote: “the court” is to be read with section 63M

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Family Law Act 1996, "force" and related expressions in relation to a marriage must be read in accordance with section 63A(4) to (6).
elements.quote: “force” (and related expressions), in relation to a marriage, are to be read in accordance with section 63A(4) to (6)

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Family Law Act 1996, "forced marriage protection order" has the meaning specified in section 63A(6).
elements.quote: “forced marriage protection order” has the meaning given by section 63A(6)

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Family Law Act 1996, "marriage" means any religious or civil ceremony of marriage, whether or not that ceremony is legally binding.
elements.quote: “marriage” means any religious or civil ceremony of marriage (whether or not legally binding)

elements.requirement: In relation to any order under this Part of the Family Law Act 1996 that was made by the High Court, "the relevant judge" means a judge of the High Court.
elements.quote: where the order was made by the High Court, a judge of that court

elements.requirement: In relation to any order under this Part of the Family Law Act 1996 that was made by the family court, "the relevant judge" means a judge of the family court.
elements.quote: where the order was made by the family court, a judge of that court
